items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I studied timpanies from a man -- he was Professor White

ctx.x: Oh, well, I studied, you know; I studied
vibes, and I studied timpanies from a man -- he was Professor White; he was about -- he was here in Los Angeles, he worked the studios, but maybe I jumped some of the things.

I believe that you have to be prepared for whatever is to come, you know? And when I was telling you when I started freelancing at the studios, then I also started studying, because when you work at the studios, I saw what the other drummers had to do, and I didn't want to be one dimensional.
